description: Approver responds to an egress-permission-request with authorization to proceed. Second event in the four-step egress lineage. Must reference its request via request_sha. Subsequent egress events must reference grant_sha.

request_sha.description: sha_seal of the egress-permission-request this grants

license.description: usage license terms (CC-BY, MIT, Open Access, etc)

scope.description: allowed URIs, domains, MCP tools — egress must match scope

expected_attribution_form.description: e.g. 'author + venue + DOI', 'repo + commit_sha', 'artist + work + year'

must_be_cited_when.description: e.g. 'any cultivation in domain D uses this source', 'any chime references derived insight'

intended_attribution_chain.description: Approver's binding commitment: when ingested content from this grant is later cited, attribution MUST follow this form. Sealed at grant-time, enforced at chime-emission-time.
